newsitem.title: CANADA: Campbell says gets Panama mine approval.
newsitem.headline: Campbell says gets Panama mine approval.

text.p: Campbell Resources Inc said on Friday it received final approval to proceed with the development of the Cerro Quema gold deposit in Panama.
The Panamanian regulatory authorities have opproved Campbell's mine exploitation and environmental permits.
Campbell said access road construction that it begun in November is close to being complete. The company will now proceed with the remainder of mine construction and development.
Production scheduling indicates that commercial gold production will begin in the second quarter of 1998.
Campbell said it has forecast production at 50,000 ounces per year for the six years of the life of the mine.
The capital cost of the mine will be approximately US$32.8 million, including provisions for contingencies. Campbell will fund this from internal funds.
